blocks.text: Ionizing radiation istemal karne wale imaging ke tareeqe is baat par chalte hain ke radiation matter se kaise interaction karti hai: tissue se guzarte photons absorb (jazb) ya scatter (bikhar) ho sakte hain, aur energy deposition (energy ke jama hone) aur attenuation (kamzor hone) ka yahi pattern detector par measurable (naapne ke qabil) signal banata hai. Nuclear medicine mein radiation mareez ke andar se aati hai, ek di gayi radioactive dawa (radiopharmaceutical) se. Is liye signal body ki anatomy (shakal aur banawat) se zyada us ka physiological function (kaam) dikhata hai. Ek important functional technique SPECT (Single Photon Emission Computed Tomography) hai: gamma rays chhorne wala tracer body mein dala jata hai aur ghoomta hua gamma camera mukhtalif directions se bohat si projection views (tasveerein) leta hai. In se tracer distribution (tracer kahan kitna phaila) ki cross-sectional images banai jati hain, jo perfusion (khoon ke pohanchne) aur organs ke function ki 3D information deti hain. PET (Positron Emission Tomography) isi idea ko positron chhorne wale tracers se aage barhata hai: positron tissue mein thora sa faasla tay kar ke ek electron se mil kar annihilate (dono khatam) hota hai aur do gamma photons taqreeban opposite (ulti) directions mein nikalte hain. In dono photons ko coincidence (ek hi lamhe) mein detect kar ke machine event (waqiye) ki location maloom karti hai aur tracer uptake (tracer ke jama hone) ka quantitative map (naqsha) banati hai. Is liye PET non-invasive technique hai jo cell/molecule ki level par metabolic aur biochemical activity (sargarmi) ki image banata hai. Yeh cancer ki early detection (jaldi pehchan) aur staging (stage maloom karna), brain (dimagh) ke function ki jaanch aur dil ki abnormalities (kharabiyon) ko wazeh anatomical (banawati) tabdeeli se pehle pakarne ke liye bohat valuable (qeemti) hai (Fig. 20.10, PET scanner ki image).

blocks.alt: PET scanner. Baen taraf PET machine, aik bari khari gantry jis ke beech gol surakh hai aur oopar chhota monitor. Daen taraf rotating scanner ka bazu screen ke saath. Mareez motorized exam table par leta hai jo surakh ke andar jati hai aur oonche base par khari hai. Oopar daen: Brain Scan, brain ke rangeen sections aur colour scale.

blocks.text: Mareez motorized exam table par leta hai aur table use PET machine ke gol surakh mein le jati hai. Machine ki ring ke detectors body se nikalne wali gamma rays pakarte hain, aur computer un se Brain Scan jaisi rangeen tasveer banata hai jis mein zyada active hissay alag rang mein nazar aate hain.
